recognize_zh: 左圖箭頭處巨噬細胞核偏心，淡藍色細胞質充滿纖維狀、帶條紋的紋理，形似揉皺的紙（crumpled tissue paper）；右圖箭頭處也有同樣淡藍灰、帶絲狀條紋的細胞質，為高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Fibrillar, striated, wrinkled 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasmic texture
Small, round to oval, eccentric nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin
Cytoplasm not vacuolated or foamy; no ingested cells
Right panel: Gaucher cell cytoplasm partly smeared among granulocytic and erythroid precursors (two-panel composite)
describe_en: Two-panel bone marrow aspirate composite (May-Grünwald-Giemsa). Among normal-appearing hematopoietic precursors are large histiocytes with small eccentric nuclei and abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm displaying a fibrillar, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' texture (arrows); in the right panel the cytoplasm is partly smeared. The cytoplasm is not vacuolated or foamy. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay and GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML, myeloma, or thalassemia are morphologically near-identical and are separated by clinical context, normal enzyme activity, and the underlying neoplasm.
Foam cells have cytoplasm filled with uniform small lipid vacuoles (soap-bubble) rather than striated fibrils.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules instead of a fibrillar texture.
MAC-laden macrophages show negative-image rod striations and are acid-fast positive.
